title: [Audit] 👤 Actor 360
description: One identity’s complete footprint — pick a person in the control bar and every panel becomes their story.

config.content:
### Everything one person did, on one page

Use it to check whether their activity is normal, see what they changed and read, and gather evidence for a review or investigation. Raw records: [All audit events](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-00-all-events), [Raw signal feed](/app/discover#/view/cloud-audit-search-10-raw-signal-feed).

**How to use it:** pick someone in the Person (email) control, or click an email in a table; with nobody selected, the page covers everyone. ① *Is this normal?* always looks at the last 7 days in UTC, ② *What they did* follows the time picker, and ③ *Evidence* ends in the raw records. Table times are in your time zone.

- A person’s own API keys carry their email, so their counts can include machine traffic; a Cloud API key belongs to no person.
- The ① panels read a fixed 7 days with no noise gate, so they will not match Signal events or the time picker.
- Baseline: the band is their usual range for each hour; with under three days of history no band is drawn.
- The Risk tile and Every scoring action count whole minutes only, so they can stop up to a minute short of the panels around them.
- Session timeline: click a bar to pin a session (Elasticsearch panels then read empty); API-only identities have no sessions.

config.title: Who this is — by email and principal id · top 5 at most
config.description: The identities behind the selection, busiest first: a person’s email and the Principal id of every signed-in principal. Click either to pin it across the suite. Requests with no identity count in the Events tile but have no row.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS events = COUNT(*) BY user.email, user.name | WHERE user.email IS NOT NULL OR NOT STARTS_WITH(user.name, "<") | SORT events DESC, user.email, user.name | LIMIT 5

config.description: Every audited event for the selection, how many distinct actions that was, and how recently they were last seen. Routine traffic included, so it counts connection housekeeping.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | STATS Events = COUNT(*), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(event.action, 100), last_ts = MAX(@timestamp) | EVAL mins = DATE_DIFF("minutes", last_ts, NOW()) | EVAL detail = CASE(Events == 0, "no activity", CONCAT(CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) <= 3, TO_STRING(actions), LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(actions), LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(actions), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(actions), LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(actions), LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(actions), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(actions), LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(actions), LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(actions), LENGTH(TO_STRING(actions)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(actions), 3))), CASE(actions == 1, " action", " actions"), " · ", CASE(mins < 1, "just now", mins < 60, CONCAT(CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) <= 3, TO_STRING(mins), LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(mins), LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(mins), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(mins), LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(mins), LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(mins), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(mins), LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(mins), LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(mins), LENGTH(TO_STRING(mins)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(mins), 3))), "m ago"), CONCAT(TO_STRING(mins / 60), "h ago")))) | KEEP Events, detail

config.description: Total risk for the selection (weight × events for everything that scored), how many scoring actions, and the highest weight; 50 is a security configuration change. Routine activity scores zero. Every scoring action below lists the receipts.

data_source.query: SET unmapped_fields="nullify"; FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp < DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, TO_DATETIME(?_tend)) AND @timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC(1 minute, TO_DATETIME(?_tstart)) + 1 minute | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL OR event.outcome == "failure" OR event.action IN ("invalidate_apikeys","anonymous_access_denied") OR (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY event.action, scc = elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, event.outcome, service.name, et = MV_CONCAT(event.type, ","), housekeeping = (event.action IS NOT NULL AND event.action == "invalidate_apikeys" AND user.name IS NOT NULL AND user.name IN ("elastic.maintenance","autoscaling","elasticsearch-controller","elastic/fleet-server","elastic/kibana") AND api_key.name IS NULL), suite_install = (kibana.saved_object.id IS NOT NULL AND (kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "cloud-audit-*" OR kibana.saved_object.id LIKE "elastic_cloud-audit-*") AND kibana.session.id IS NULL) | EVAL event.type = SPLIT(et, ","), elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change = CASE(scc, "present") | EVAL risk = CASE(housekeeping, 0, event.action == "invalidate_apikeys", 45, event.action == "anonymous_access_denied", 35, elasticsearch.audit.security_config_change IS NOT NULL, 50, event.outcome == "failure", 40, suite_install, 0, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND event.action IN ("workflow_run","workflow_test","workflow_execution_cancel"), 10, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) AND (event.type == "deletion" OR event.action == "rule_disable"), 30, (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))), 25, 0) | WHERE risk > 0 | STATS sev = SUM(risk * n) BY event.action, risk | STATS Risk = SUM(sev), worst = MAX(risk), kinds = COUNT(*) | EVAL detail = CASE(worst IS NULL, "nothing scored", CONCAT(CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) <= 3, TO_STRING(kinds), LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(kinds), LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(kinds), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(kinds), LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(kinds), LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(kinds), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(kinds), LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(kinds), LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(kinds), LENGTH(TO_STRING(kinds)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(kinds), 3))), CASE(kinds == 1, " action · worst ", " actions · worst "), CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) <= 3, TO_STRING(worst), LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(worst), LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(worst), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(worst), LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(worst), LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(worst), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(worst), LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(worst), LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(worst), LENGTH(TO_STRING(worst)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(worst), 3))))), Risk = COALESCE(Risk, 0) | KEEP Risk, detail

config.description: How widely this selection reaches into Elasticsearch: index families named in their requests, and how many distinct indices those families hold. Dated and backing indices fold into one family, so thirty days of a daily index is one.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | STATS idx = VALUES(elasticsearch.audit.indices) | MV_EXPAND idx | EVAL name = CASE(LOCATE(idx, "*") > 0 OR STARTS_WITH(idx, "<"), null, idx) | EVAL family = REPLACE(REPLACE(name, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | STATS `Index families` = COUNT_DISTINCT(family), names = COUNT_DISTINCT(name) | EVAL detail = CASE(names == 0, "no index named", CONCAT("from ", CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) <= 3, TO_STRING(names), LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(names), LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(names), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(names), LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(names), LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(names), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(names), LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(names), LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(names), LENGTH(TO_STRING(names)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(names), 3))), CASE(names == 1, " index", " indices"))) | KEEP `Index families`, detail

config.description: Distinct real client addresses for this selection, how many countries they resolve to, and how many cannot be placed (always so for a private address). Many addresses for one named person is the shared-credential signal.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE client.ip IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), country = MAX(client.geo.country_name), city = MAX(client.geo.city_name), placed = COUNT(client.geo.country_iso_code) BY client.ip | STATS `Client IPs` = COUNT(*), countries = COUNT_DISTINCT(country), unplaced = SUM(CASE(placed == 0, 1, 0)) | EVAL detail = CASE(`Client IPs` == 0, "no client address", CONCAT(CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) <= 3, TO_STRING(countries), LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(countries), LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(countries), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(countries), LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(countries), LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(countries), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(countries), LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(countries), LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(countries), LENGTH(TO_STRING(countries)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(countries), 3))), CASE(countries == 1, " country · ", " countries · "), CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) <= 3, TO_STRING(unplaced), LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(unplaced), LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(unplaced), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(unplaced), LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(unplaced), LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(unplaced), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(unplaced), LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(unplaced), LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(unplaced), LENGTH(TO_STRING(unplaced)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(unplaced), 3))), " unplaced")) | KEEP `Client IPs`, detail

config.title: Every scoring action and its weight, largest first · its Sum is the Risk tile
config.description: The receipts for the Risk tile: one row per scoring action and weight, largest first; scroll for more. Risk is weight × events, and the Sum under it is the tile's number. Click an action, then Open in Security & Anomalies.

config.content: #### ① Is this normal? · _fixed 7-day window in UTC (ignores the time picker)_

config.title: Is this normal for them? — hourly, last 7 days (UTC)
config.description: Hourly activity over the last 7 days against this selection’s own usual range for each hour of day (the shaded band). A marked point is an hour well outside their usual range. A sanity check, not a detector. UTC.

config.title: Where they rank — last 7 days
config.description: Up to 40 busiest people over the last 7 days, ranked by percentile on three measures: how much they did, how many different things, and kinds of Kibana object. The selected person is an orange diamond; hover for raw numbers.

config.title: Working rhythm — last 7 days (UTC)
config.description: Every event for this selection by hour of day and day of week, last 7 days in UTC. Each cell is one real hour; stronger color means more. Grey means no activity; the current hour is outlined while it fills.

config.content: #### ② What they did · _follows the time picker · times in your time zone_

config.title: How they reached what they touched in Kibana — credential → space → object → operation
config.description: This selection’s Kibana activity: credential, space, object type, then what was done. Wider ribbons mean more events. A person in a browser arrives by SAML SSO; a script by API key. Click a credential or space to pin it.

config.title: ⚠️ What they changed — deletes first, then newest · up to 100
config.description: What this selection changed, ran or deleted in Kibana: deletes first, then newest first, up to 100 rows. “(failed)” marks a denied change; other rows are changes Kibana recorded as attempted or completed. Scroll for more.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE (service.name == "serverless-kibana" AND ((event.type IN ("change","creation","deletion") AND (event.action IS NULL OR NOT (event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time","saved_object_close_point_in_time")))) OR event.action IN ("rule_run_soon","secret_create"))) | GROK body.text """\[(?:id|workflowId)=%{DATA:g_id}(?:,|\])""" | GROK body.text """\[name=%{GREEDYDATA:g_name}\]""" | GROK body.text """\[executionId=%{DATA:g_exec}\]""" | GROK body.text """case id: %{NOTSPACE:g_case}""" | GROK body.text """(?:job|datafeed) %{NOTSPACE:g_ml}""" | EVAL obj_name = COALESCE(kibana.saved_object.name, g_name, g_id, kibana.saved_object.id, g_case, g_ml, g_exec, body.text) | EVAL result = CASE(event.outcome == "unknown", "attempted", event.outcome) | EVAL execution = COALESCE(LEFT(g_exec, 8), "—") | EVAL req = CASE(event.action IN ("space_delete", "saved_object_delete"), http.request.id) | STATS n = COUNT(*), last_ts = MAX(@timestamp) BY event.action, kibana.saved_object.type, obj_name, execution, space = kibana.space.id, result, req | EVAL pack = CONCAT(COALESCE(event.action, ""), "␞", COALESCE(kibana.saved_object.type, ""), "␞", COALESCE(obj_name, ""), "␞", COALESCE(execution, ""), "␞", COALESCE(space, ""), "␞", COALESCE(result, ""), "␞", TO_STRING(n), "␞", TO_STRING(last_ts)), sd = event.action == "space_delete" | STATS n = SUM(n), inside = SUM(n) WHERE event.action == "saved_object_delete", last_ts = MAX(last_ts), gone = COUNT(*) WHERE sd, sname = MAX(obj_name) WHERE sd, sspace = MAX(space) WHERE sd, sres = MAX(result) WHERE sd, rows = VALUES(pack) BY k = COALESCE(req, pack) | EVAL rows = CASE(gone > 0, CONCAT("space_delete␞space␞", COALESCE(sname, "a deleted space"), "␞—␞", COALESCE(sspace, ""), "␞", COALESCE(sres, ""), "␞", TO_STRING(n), "␞", TO_STRING(last_ts)), rows), inside = CASE(gone > 0, inside, 0) | MV_EXPAND rows | DISSECT rows "%{a}␞%{t}␞%{obj_name}␞%{execution}␞%{sp}␞%{res}␞%{ns}␞%{ts}" | EVAL event.action = CASE(a == "", null, a), kibana.saved_object.type = CASE(t == "", null, t), space = CASE(sp == "", null, sp), result = CASE(res == "", null, res), n = TO_LONG(ns), last_ts = TO_DATETIME(ts) | STATS n = SUM(n), inside = SUM(inside), last_ts = MAX(last_ts) BY event.action, kibana.saved_object.type, obj_name, execution, space, result | EVAL verb = CASE(event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | EVAL obj_type = CASE(kibana.saved_object.type IS NOT NULL, kibana.saved_object.type, event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_job", "ml-job", event.action LIKE "ml_*ad_datafeed", "ml-datafeed", event.action LIKE "workflow_execution_*", "workflow-execution", event.action LIKE "workflow_*", "workflow", event.action LIKE "agent_builder_agent_*", "agent-builder-agent", event.action LIKE "agent_builder_tool_*", "agent-builder-tool", event.action LIKE "product_documentation_*", "product-documentation", event.action == "secret_create", "secret", event.action IS NULL, "unclassified", REPLACE(event.action, "_(create|update|delete|enable|disable|run|run_soon|test|cancel)$", "")) | STATS events = SUM(n), inside = SUM(inside), last_seen = MAX(last_ts) BY verb, type = obj_type, name = obj_name, execution, space, result | EVAL name = CASE(execution == "—", name, CONCAT(name, " · run ", execution)), type = REPLACE(type, "-", " "), gone = verb == "delete" | EVAL name = CASE(inside > 0, CONCAT(name, " · and the ", CASE(LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) <= 3, TO_STRING(inside), LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) <= 6, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(inside), LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) - 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(inside), 3)), LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) <= 9, CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(inside), LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) - 6), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(inside), LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(inside), 3)), CONCAT(LEFT(TO_STRING(inside), LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) - 9), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(inside), LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) - 8, 3), ",", SUBSTRING(TO_STRING(inside), LENGTH(TO_STRING(inside)) - 5, 3), ",", RIGHT(TO_STRING(inside), 3))), CASE(inside == 1, " object in it", " objects in it")), name) | EVAL verb = CASE(result == "failure", CONCAT(verb, " (failed)"), verb) | DROP execution, result, inside | SORT gone DESC, last_seen DESC | DROP gone | LIMIT 100

config.title: What they read, by index family · top 9 at most
config.description: The index families this selection read most, busiest first. Dated and backing indices fold into one family; Indices counts how many of its members were read. The audit stream usually tops the list because these dashboards read it.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | MV_EXPAND elasticsearch.audit.indices | STATS n = COUNT(*) BY elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE NOT (LOCATE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") > 0 OR STARTS_WITH(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "<")) | EVAL family = REPLACE(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | STATS events = SUM(n), indices = COUNT(*) BY family | SORT events DESC, family | LIMIT 9

config.title: ⚠️ System and hidden index reads · top 9 at most (empty = good)
config.description: The system and hidden index families this selection read, counted as in “What they read, by index family” beside it. Click a row to pin it, then open Elasticsearch Data Access to see who else reads it.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices IS NOT NULL | MV_EXPAND elasticsearch.audit.indices | WHERE ((elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".*" AND NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*") OR elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-.*") AND (elasticsearch.audit.action IS NULL OR NOT elasticsearch.audit.action LIKE "*[*") | STATS n = COUNT(*), seen = MAX(@timestamp) BY elasticsearch.audit.indices, action = elasticsearch.audit.action | WHERE NOT (LOCATE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "*") > 0 OR STARTS_WITH(elasticsearch.audit.indices, "<")) | EVAL family = REPLACE(REPLACE(elasticsearch.audit.indices, """^\.ds-""", ""), """[-.]?\d{4}[.-]\d{2}[.-]\d{2}(-\d+)?$""", "") | INLINE STATS events = SUM(n), indices = COUNT_DISTINCT(elasticsearch.audit.indices), actions = COUNT_DISTINCT(action), last_seen = MAX(seen), named_idx = MIN(elasticsearch.audit.indices) WHERE NOT elasticsearch.audit.indices LIKE ".ds-*", any_idx = MIN(elasticsearch.audit.indices) BY family | WHERE elasticsearch.audit.indices == COALESCE(named_idx, any_idx) | STATS events = MAX(events), indices = MAX(indices), actions = MAX(actions), last_seen = MAX(last_seen) BY elasticsearch.audit.indices, family | SORT events DESC, family | LIMIT 9

config.title: Where they connected from
config.description: Where this selection connected from: dots are locations sized by activity; lines join one location to the next, colored by the travel speed implied. Read the title line first: many events cannot be placed. Not an impossible-travel detector.

config.title: Busiest addresses they used · top 10 at most
config.description: This selection’s real client addresses, busiest first, including ones the map cannot show. “unplaced” means no location was found, always so for a private address; “—” is a country with no city. Click an address to pin it.

data_source.query: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE @timestamp <= ?_tend AND @timestamp > ?_tstart | WHERE client.ip IS NOT NULL | STATS events = COUNT(*), last_seen = MAX(@timestamp), country = MAX(client.geo.country_name), city = MAX(client.geo.city_name), placed = COUNT(client.geo.country_iso_code) BY client.ip | EVAL city = CASE(placed == 0, "unplaced", COALESCE(city, "—")), country = CASE(placed == 0, "unplaced", country) | SORT events DESC | LIMIT 10

config.content: #### ③ Evidence · _session timeline is fixed at 24 hours · the records follow the time picker · your time zone_

config.title: Kibana browser sessions · fixed last 24 hours, your time zone
config.description: The 12 most recent Kibana browser sessions in the last 24 hours: length is how long, shade is how much was done. Click a bar to show that session’s records below. API-key work has no session. Ignores the time picker.

config.title: Session records · newest 1,000 at most (empty when none in range)
config.description: The raw Kibana events behind the session timeline, newest first. Click a timeline bar or filter on a session id to read one session. Capped at the newest 1,000; an hour with only an idle Kibana tab is empty.
